svg.desc: Real-time Android messenger (Java 21 LTS, Material 3 XML Views) & Spring Boot 3 / PostgreSQL backend: 1-1 and group chat over STOMP/WebSocket, media sharing, 1-1 voice calls, bilingual Vi/En UI, and AI catch-up summaries. Main language: Java.
